scenarios: NS-01 through NS-24 retain their full-program contracts. Bounded C1.1–C2.3 local software execution is recorded in implementation_slices; professional/platform/production acceptance is not inferred.
interpretation: Scenarios are partial evidence slices for the existing full-program requirements; they do not replace C3-C8 professional/target-environment release gates. FIN-01 full acceptance still includes RX-02; the C2 bridge covers non-drug performed events only.

requirements.problem: Contacts and accounts cannot represent verified patient delegation.
requirements.invariant: Actor, subject, verified basis, action scope and current revision are distinct; existing self-access and receipts remain intact.
requirements.failure_response: Pending/refused/expired/revoked authority has an explicit front-desk resolution path; no unauthorized effect or receipt disclosure.
requirements.requirement_title: Verified patients guardians and source-aware import

requirements.problem: Restricted branch search can create duplicates while broad chart access leaks sensitive data.
requirements.invariant: Only restricted identity resolution and explicit care authority permit cross-clinic continuity; shared phone is not identity proof.
requirements.failure_response: Route ambiguous identity or missing referral authority to reviewed resolution without global chart exposure.
requirements.requirement_title: Restricted cross-clinic identity resolution and shared-care authority

requirements.problem: Directory qualifications do not establish current professional permission.
requirements.invariant: Professional action requires accountable person, effective clinic/service/care scope and validity; role switching cannot self-review.
requirements.failure_response: Expired/withdrawn scope blocks new privileged effects and preserves historical decisions.
requirements.requirement_title: Clinical professional scope and attributable permissions

requirements.problem: Departure and account recovery can leave obsolete capabilities.
requirements.invariant: Authentication and applicable session revocation remain aligned with current authority.
requirements.failure_response: Reject stale capability with recoverable login/role path; no reused demo credentials for customer initialization.
requirements.requirement_title: Customer account activation recovery and session governance

requirements.problem: Billing notes do not provide structured attributed clinical continuity.
requirements.invariant: Actual encounter and reported/reviewed facts are distinct; draft subject/version is fixed.
requirements.failure_response: Conflicting edits preserve recoverable work; unreviewed history cannot silently replace clinical evidence.
requirements.requirement_title: Structured dental encounters and quality worklists

requirements.problem: Tooth/surface findings cannot be reliably reconstructed from charge descriptions.
requirements.invariant: Tooth numbering/dentition, surface, provenance and version are explicit; keyboard and graphical input preserve the same fact.
requirements.failure_response: Invalid/ambiguous findings require review, with UNKNOWN retained and no fabricated procedure.
requirements.requirement_title: Odontogram periodontal data and service-specific dental findings

requirements.problem: Single-visit records lose plan alternatives and unfinished treatment.
requirements.invariant: Accepted version, actual performance, consent and money are separate; only performed events enter the unique charging bridge.
requirements.failure_response: A revised/refused/partial plan preserves original acceptance and completed events; no silent new bill/refund.
requirements.requirement_title: Longitudinal treatment plans and safe draft saving

requirements.problem: Cancellation follow-up does not track clinically due continuing care.
requirements.invariant: Clinical due window is owned by clinical staff; front desk owns contact/booking; completion needs the defined actual-care fact.
requirements.failure_response: Cancelled appointment, declined contact or unreachable patient leaves an attributed resolution rather than false completion.

requirements.problem: An apparently free slot can be unusable if a required lab case is late or rejected.
requirements.invariant: Dispatch/receipt/quality acceptance are distinct; required readiness is checked without silently breaking the promised appointment.
requirements.failure_response: Delay or rework creates accountable coordination; front desk obtains explicit reschedule/cancellation decisions.
requirements.requirement_title: Internal laboratory cases and appointment readiness

requirements.problem: Plan and actual care can otherwise create independent duplicate charge sources.
requirements.invariant: Typed unique performed source feeds existing finance commands; estimates are not revenue and historical money is unchanged.
requirements.failure_response: Duplicate/revised clinical input preserves committed money; financial correction follows existing reviewed path.
requirements.requirement_title: Clinical source charges and treatment-course allocations

requirements.problem: Write authorization alone does not control sensitive reads or exports.
requirements.invariant: Read/export follows patient/object/action/purpose scope with attributable bounded audit, excluding raw medical text from runtime logs.
requirements.failure_response: Wrong subject/clinic or revoked authority denies disclosure and records safe evidence.
requirements.requirement_title: Sensitive read export retention and processor governance

requirements.problem: A clinical save or financial approval does not prove clinical consent or signing.
requirements.invariant: Plan acceptance is distinct from informed consent; only implemented reviewed signing evidence may be labeled signed.
requirements.failure_response: Missing signing/consent prerequisite remains visible; do not substitute billing or role-switch approval.
requirements.requirement_title: Consent archive controlled copies and retention

requirements.problem: Corrections must preserve the earlier clinical evidence.
requirements.invariant: Signed original and attributed amendments remain readable and separately linked from financial versions.
requirements.failure_response: Reject destructive rewrite; retain original and explicitly route the amendment/copy process.
requirements.requirement_title: Clinical signatures and immutable amendment lifecycle

requirements.problem: Scheduling and completion metrics can misclassify rescheduling and open cohorts.
requirements.invariant: Versioned denominators distinguish appointment episode, actual care, contact and cash; HQ sees only authorized aggregates.
requirements.failure_response: Missing/unmatured data is identified, not coerced to zero or successful care.
requirements.requirement_title: Consistent clinical and operational outcome measures

requirements.problem: New identities and clinical sources can detach historical records during migration.
requirements.invariant: All 40 migrations and existing facts remain unchanged; new records have provenance and independently checked source links.
requirements.failure_response: Stop cutover on mismatch; preserve source and execute reviewed forward/recovery path without fabricated historical facts.
requirements.requirement_title: Additive clinical migration and rehearsed replacement cutover

requirements.problem: Existing scheduling load does not qualify a new clinical workload.
requirements.invariant: Exact-version business, concurrency, usability and target-workload evidence establishes only its declared scope.
requirements.failure_response: Retain failed/unexecuted gates; no production or WeChat-runtime claim from mocks or old load.
requirements.requirement_title: Clinical safety security usability and commercial capacity qualification

implementation_slices.scope: current-clinic relationship verification, appointment-only grants and explicit website/native patient selection
implementation_slices.full_program_gates: Clinical consent, source-aware imports, shared care and professional qualification remain incomplete.

implementation_slices.scope: Independent clinic/service/action professional decisions, controlled referral identity and disclosure, sensitive-read and departure enforcement
implementation_slices.full_program_gates: Synthetic source and software behavior do not qualify clinical reviewers or complete C2–C8.

implementation_slices.scope: Reported versus reviewed history, actual encounter, tooth/surface/dentition, safe draft conflicts, versioned examinations and selected referral
implementation_slices.full_program_gates: Qualified templates, periodontal breadth and clinical replacement remain distinct.

implementation_slices.scope: Retained plan/catalogue definitions, exact-version patient decisions, partial and complete actual care, unique non-drug original charge and explicit next-visit links
implementation_slices.full_program_gates: Discussion acceptance is not qualified informed consent. Prescribing and full FIN-01 allocation/integration remain separate.

implementation_slices.scope: Clinician-directed completion rules, attributed recall work, manual lab logistics, exact-step/cycle acceptance and readiness, management state counts
implementation_slices.full_program_gates: Real supplier exchange, full QC cohorts, clinical qualification and platform/cloud acceptance remain outstanding.
